properties.site-address: Land to rear of 11-15 The Mall, W5
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.name: P/2014/3193
properties.notes: Extant permission is in place for 14 units.. Re-development of land at the rear of Nos 11 to 15 The Mall to provide a part single, part two, part three, part four and part five storey building with basement, comprising 14 self-contained flats (6 x 1 bed, 6 x 2 bed and 2 x 3 bed) arranged over the first to fourth floor (following part demolition of the existing extensions and structures to the rear of Nos. 11 to 15); change of use of ground floor of No. 12 The Mall from A1 Retail to C3 Residential (to form Entrance Lobby to Flats), to include alteration to front facade; alterations to existing air extract plant at Nos. 11, 12 and 13; one disabled parking space; bicycle, refuse and recycling stores (Ref. P/2014/3193).
